summary: Two male skiers (ages 55 and 57) skied out-of-bounds at the base of Walsh's double-black run on Aspen Mountain (Ajax); Aspen Mountain Ski Patrol found their fresh tracks under the ski-area boundary but without a confirmed need for help did not follow. Pitkin County deputies and Mountain Rescue Aspen volunteers mobilized a ground team near North Star preserve at the base of the mountain; crews made cell-phone contact and directed the skiers down a tight narrow ravine, then escorted them across the wildlife refuge and through the river to volunteers staged at the highway. Both skiers healthy and in good spirits; all personnel out of the field by 4:45 p.m.
responding_agency: Pitkin County Sheriff's Office; Mountain Rescue Aspen; Aspen Mountain Ski Patrol
